# SkiaSharp to browser compatibility research

Research date: 2026-09-11. This document describes the upstream API and candidate implementation mechanisms. It does **not** certify implementation coverage in the accompanying JavaScript library.

## Pinned references

- [SkiaSharp source](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/tree/b33cf54f24edc5347567c95b1924c447669c1de8), main commit `b33cf54f24edc5347567c95b1924c447669c1de8`, committed 2026-09-08.
- [CanvasKit public TypeScript declarations](https://github.com/google/skia/blob/f446aec4ce9e0e95e0a504e875955de3eb521f75/modules/canvaskit/npm_build/types/index.d.ts), Skia main commit `f446aec4ce9e0e95e0a504e875955de3eb521f75`.
- [CanvasKit native bindings](https://github.com/google/skia/blob/f446aec4ce9e0e95e0a504e875955de3eb521f75/modules/canvaskit/canvaskit_bindings.cpp), [build configuration](https://github.com/google/skia/blob/f446aec4ce9e0e95e0a504e875955de3eb521f75/modules/canvaskit/compile.sh), and [WebGPU adapter](https://github.com/google/skia/blob/f446aec4ce9e0e95e0a504e875955de3eb521f75/modules/canvaskit/webgpu.js).

The downloaded C# snapshot covers 229 files and the lexical inventory finds 323 namespace-qualified public type identities and 3,995 public member declarations, including overloads and enum values. It merges partial classes, includes conditional branches together, and does not expand inherited or compiler-generated members. This is a practical review checklist; exact API certification requires compiled reference metadata and behavior tests. See `upstream-public-api.json` and `UPSTREAM_API_INVENTORY.md`.

## Family mapping

| Upstream family | Principal types | Browser implementation route | Significant parity work beyond basic CanvasKit wrappers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Colors and geometry | `SKColor`, `SKColorF`, `SKColors`, `SKPMColor`, `SKPoint`, `SKPointI`, `SKSize`, `SKSizeI`, `SKRect`, `SKRectI`, `SKMatrix`, `SKMatrix44`, `SKRotationScaleMatrix`, `SKRoundRect` | JavaScript value types; typed arrays at native boundary | Packed ARGB versus RGBA conversion, equality, integer rounding, perspective matrices, operator replacements and `ref`/`out` results. |
| Drawing and state | `SKCanvas`, `SKSurface`, `SKPaint`, `SKSurfaceProperties` | Native CanvasKit Canvas/Surface/Paint; HTML canvas presentation | Audit every drawing overload, sampling, clip semantics, transforms, save layers and paint ownership. `DrawText` overloads should follow modern explicit `SKFont` semantics while preserving legacy paint text settings where promised. |
| Paths | `SKPath`, `SKPathBuilder`, `SKPathMeasure`, `SKPath.Iterator`, `SKPath.RawIterator`, `SKPath.OpBuilder` | CanvasKit Path/PathBuilder, PathOps and contour measurements | CanvasKit 0.41 made paths immutable; adapt a mutable .NET-style facade with snapshots. Preserve rational conics, direction, fill type, path verbs, relative commands, arc overload dispatch and iterator semantics. |
| Regions | `SKRegion` and its rect/clip/span iterators | Dedicated integer region engine or additional native bindings | CanvasKit public types do not expose the SkRegion family. Path boolean operations alone are not identical to integer region rasterization. |
| Shaders and blending | `SKShader`, `SKBlender`, `SKRuntimeEffect`, runtime uniform/child builders | CanvasKit gradients, image shaders, noise and runtime shader/blender compiler | Uniform layouts and child ownership; runtime color-filter creation is not exposed equivalently. Perspective/local matrices and gradient interpolation options require overload audits. |
| Color and mask effects | `SKColorFilter`, `SKMaskFilter` | CanvasKit native factories | Compare factory availability and clamp/composition/lighting semantics. Missing native factories require an actual implementation, not a renamed no-op. |
| Image effects | `SKImageFilter` | CanvasKit ImageFilter factories plus custom shaders/native additions | CanvasKit exposes a smaller set: arithmetic, crop, magnifier, convolution, merge, tile, picture and the six lighting filter factories need separate scrutiny or implementation. Bounds/crop behavior matters as much as pixel appearance. |
| Path effects | `SKPathEffect` | CanvasKit dash, corner, discrete, 1D path, 2D line/path | .NET compose, sum and trim factories need additional work; path trimming is available as a path operation but differs from a reusable paint effect. |
| Images and pixel buffers | `SKImage`, `SKBitmap`, `SKPixmap`, `SKImageInfo`, `SKImageReadPixelsResult` | CanvasKit images/readback plus owned JavaScript buffers | `SKBitmap` is mutable while `SKImage` is immutable. Row bytes, premultiplication, color type, subset extraction, buffer ownership, mutation notifications and async GPU readback require explicit semantics. |
| Codecs | `SKCodec`, encoder structs, `SKWebpEncoder` | CanvasKit decoding/animated images and browser encoders where available | Incremental and scanline decoding, frame dependency metadata, EXIF orientation and exact encode format/quality/options are not a one-to-one public CanvasKit API. Never silently encode PNG for a requested JPEG/WebP format. |
| Pictures and drawables | `SKPicture`, `SKPictureRecorder`, `SKDrawable`, `SKNWayCanvas`, `SKNoDrawCanvas`, `SKOverdrawCanvas` | Native CanvasKit picture recording and serialization; forwarding canvas wrappers | Drawable subclass callbacks, invalidation, GPU context resources and serialization compatibility across Skia revisions need verification. |
| Documents | `SKDocument`, `SKDocumentPdfMetadata`, `SKDocumentPdfStructureElement`, `SKSvgCanvas` | Dedicated browser PDF/SVG document writer or custom Skia document bindings | The normal CanvasKit public API has no general SkDocument PDF/XPS wrapper. Raster pages inside PDF are useful but do not preserve vector content, text search, links, tagging or all metadata. Native XPS is separate. |
| Color management | `SKColorSpace`, `SKColorSpaceIccProfile`, `SKColorSpaceTransferFn`, `SKColorSpaceXyz`, `SKHighContrastConfig` | Exposed CanvasKit color spaces plus parser/color-transform code where necessary | ICC/CICP creation, profile export, numerical transfer functions, HDR/wide gamut and browser presentation capability are distinct requirements. |
| Font discovery and style matching | `SKFontManager`, `SKFontStyleSet`, `SKFontStyle` | Explicit uploaded font registry and CanvasKit FontMgr/TypefaceFontProvider | Full style sets, indexed style names, CSS-like style matching and BCP47 fallback selection must be built. Normal browser APIs do not enumerate every OS font automatically. |
| Font data and variations | `SKTypeface`, `SKFontArguments`, `SKFontVariationAxis`, `SKFontVariation`, `SKFontPaletteOverride` | CanvasKit font loading plus real OpenType parsing or additional native bindings | Tables, kerning pairs, units per em, names, TTC index, variable axes/coordinates, palette overrides and variation cloning exceed the narrow CanvasKit Typeface interface. |
| Glyphs and text | `SKFont`, `SKFontMetrics`, `SKTextBlob`, `SKTextBlobBuilder`, run buffer types | CanvasKit Font/TextBlob; font parser for outlines; SkParagraph for shaping/layout | Explicit glyph IDs and positions differ from Unicode strings. Glyph outline extraction, run clusters, UTF-8/16/32 decoding, hinting flags and positioned/RSXform runs need tests. |
| HarfBuzz integration | `SkiaSharp.HarfBuzz.SKShaper` and extension methods | HarfBuzz WASM or CanvasKit SkParagraph for suitable higher-level use | SkParagraph output is not the same public contract as `SKShaper.Result` glyph IDs, positions, clusters and total width. Complex scripts, ligatures, bidi and language selection need actual shaping. |
| Data and streams | `SKData`, `SKStream`, `SKWStream`, memory/file/managed/front-buffered stream subclasses | Uint8Array/DataView buffers and async fetch/file adapters | Synchronous native file APIs and unmanaged pointers require documented web equivalents. Preserve seek/rewind/read/write/count semantics and ownership. |
| Graphics cache and lifetime | `SKObject`, `SKGraphics`, `SKTraceMemoryDump` | Deterministic `Dispose`/`delete`, native cache APIs where exposed | .NET native handle values, reference counting, finalization and full process-wide cache diagnostics do not map directly. |
| Ganesh and native GPU interop | `GRContext`, `GRRecordingContext`, `GRBackendTexture`, `GRBackendRenderTarget`, backend contexts/interfaces and options | WebGL context adapters | Raw Vulkan, Metal, D3D and native OpenGL handles are unavailable as interchangeable browser resources. Browser WebGPU/WebGL descriptors must be explicit adaptations. |
| Graphite | `SKGraphiteContext`, `SKGraphiteRecorder`, `SKGraphiteRecording`, `SKGraphiteBackendTexture`, `SKGraphiteTextureInfo`, image cache and Dawn/Metal/Vulkan contexts | Custom Graphite-enabled CanvasKit build with exposed recorder/context APIs | A CanvasKit canvas wrapper or a GPU texture compositor does not implement this .NET object model. Full native descriptor interop cannot be made identical in ordinary browser JS. |
| Animation and scene graph | `SkiaSharp.Skottie.Animation`, `AnimationBuilder`, stats; scene invalidation and resources | CanvasKit Skottie/ManagedAnimation and a browser resource provider | Resource callbacks, error reporting, property updates, timing and invalidation contracts require adapters and explicit supported formats. |
| Platform controls | MAUI, Uno, Blazor, WPF, WinForms, Android, Apple, GTK and Tizen view namespaces | Web component with resize, paint, pointer/touch, DPI and invalidation events | Browser equivalents can preserve an ergonomic view API; framework-specific inheritance, dependency/bindable properties and native control handles are not JavaScript parity. |

## Rendering backend findings

CanvasKit includes genuine Skia raster, WebGL and WebGPU code paths in source. The pinned `compile.sh` selects the WebGPU/Graphite variant when invoked with `webgpu`; otherwise its default is WebGL/Ganesh. These are build choices. The pinned npm package manifest declares version `0.42.0` in source and exports default, full and profiling bundles; that manifest alone does not prove that a published package contains a working WebGPU bundle.

Check runtime feature exports and exercise rendering before claiming a particular native backend. A WebGPU compositor that uploads software-rendered Skia pixels does use WebGPU for presentation, but shape rasterization and text remain on the CPU. Identify such a route as **Skia raster + WebGPU presentation**. Apply the same distinction to WebGL presentation. A context-loss or device-loss fallback must reacquire a fresh presentation canvas/context when the previous context type has already been locked.

Pin the actual shipped CanvasKit version independently from the .NET reference commit. CanvasKit `0.41.0` introduced immutable paths; `0.41.1` addressed PathBuilder performance. A facade built against `0.40` mutation methods cannot simply replace its dependency with `0.41+` without changes.

## Font compatibility recommendations

1. Keep a real font registry with source bytes, canonical family/subfamily, weight, width, slant, index and variation state. CanvasKit native objects can be transient views of this registry.
2. Distinguish loaded fonts from optional locally enumerated fonts. Expose local font access as an explicit user action where supported; do not pretend that CSS family names provide font bytes, table access or glyph outlines.
3. Map Unicode scalars rather than JavaScript UTF-16 code units. Preserve glyph zero as the missing-glyph sentinel; test supplementary planes and symbol cmap subtables.
4. Implement glyph metrics and outlines from the same variation instance used for drawing. Static outlines paired with variable-font drawing produce inconsistent bounds and paths.
5. Shape complex scripts before explicit glyph rendering. `getGlyphIDs` plus summed advances does not implement ligatures, Arabic shaping, Indic reordering or bidi layout.
6. Treat an unsupported font format, outline format or variation operation as an explicit error. Unsupported table parsing must not silently return invented zeros and appear complete.

## API and test recommendations

Use PascalCase exports, properties and factory names as the primary .NET migration API. JavaScript cannot overload on C# static types; dispatch by argument count and structural type with clear validation. Represent `out` results consistently as named result objects, support typed arrays for spans, provide deterministic `Dispose()` and `[Symbol.dispose]()` where available, and make browser I/O asynchronous at clearly named boundaries.

Keep an explicit compatibility entry for each upstream type/member name with implementation status and test references. Count exact overloads separately when claiming API parity. A generated export, a method that always returns a default, and a method that throws `NotSupportedError` are not implemented functionality.

The most valuable conformance tests are numerical geometry/transform results, save/clip state, premultiplication and row-stride pixel buffers, path boolean/measure output, image format signatures, font cmap/glyph metrics/outlines, actual complex-script shaping, snapshot ownership after disposal, CPU-versus-GPU visual comparisons and backend-loss recovery. Record which native backend was truly exercised.
